interactive-browser-check.title: Interactive browser check
steps: Start the service from the release archive: taskworker serve. Open http://127.0.0.1:7433 in a browser.
Pick an installed model whose text_generation capability is true, enter a role, a system prompt and a prompt, and submit. Watch the output stream in.
Cancel a running job. Confirm the state becomes cancelled and the partial output stays.
Reload the page in the middle of a running job. Confirm the job list and the running output come back.
Pause the queue, submit two jobs, and confirm they wait. Resume and confirm they run in order.
With the page open, submit a job from the command line (taskworker submit --command job.json). Confirm it appears in the page live.

quickstart-on-real-ollama.title: README quick start on real Ollama
steps: With Ollama 0.18.3 running and a small text model installed, extract the release archive for your platform.
Follow the README Quick start exactly: taskworker serve, then save job.json and run taskworker submit --command job.json --wait --timeout 2m.
Confirm the job succeeds with real output, that submitting the same file again returns the same job, and that the UI shows it.

ci-green.title: CI is green for the release commit
steps: Push the release commit and wait for every job of .github/workflows/ci.yml to finish.
Confirm all jobs are green (the optional arm64 job may be marked as allowed to fail).
Record it while the release commit is checked out: attest ci-green with the run URL in the note.
